CustomMetadata.label: AI agent users have least privilege

values.value: Apply the principle of least privilege to agents: give each agent user a dedicated permission set with only the objects and fields its use case needs. Remove any 'all data' permissions straight away.
No AI agent user holds View All Data, Modify All Data, or object-level View All / Modify All.

Finds AI users (users on an agent profile such as 'Einstein Agent User', plus every integration user registered on a use case) and checks whether they hold View All Data, Modify All Data, or object-level View All / Modify All.
